material.title: International Tourism — Academic Writing Task 2B
material.source_version: IELTS Sample Tasks 2023; isolated prompt excerpt

verification.method: Official PDF fetched HTTP 200; content and question/page ranges inspected; prompt excerpt reopened and rendered for QA

freshness.basis: PROFILE.md, PROGRESS.md and AUDIT.md read on 2026-10-12; confirm learner has not seen key at session start

material.delivery: Give local prompt-only file; do not give bundled source, key or sample responses before done. Resolve relative local file path against the project root.

result_collection.primary: learner response in chat or text file

difficulty.note: No official band or difficulty assigned to this extract.

suggested_session.coach_timing_estimate: 2 minutes prompt, 3 minutes plan a position, 8 minutes one developed paragraph in English, 7 minutes feedback and one revision
suggested_session.score_policy: Micro-task feedback against relevant IELTS criteria; do not give a whole-task band from one paragraph. Full task later in a long session.

conditions.assigned_output: Satu kalimat posisi + satu paragraf pendukung, sekitar 100–130 kata total. Posisi menjawab apakah disadvantages outweigh advantages, satu alasan dijelaskan dengan contoh.
conditions.score_policy: Feedback aspek terlihat saja; tanpa band task. Adaptasi coach dari prompt resmi, bukan esai penuh 250 kata/40 menit.
